changes: First release, for Analog Rytm MKII OS 1.74: the AMP envelope reworked, and every envelope knob shows its time.
AMP HLD runs from no hold (0) to AUTO (127) and never cuts the attack; FUNC + turn jumps 0, 125 ms, AUTO.
ATK, AMP DEC and FILTER DEC/REL step 0.2 ms up to 5 ms, then finer than stock up to 300 ms; HLD steps 0.67 ms.
SOUND SETTINGS > ENV RESET gains AMP: sequenced trigs and retrig rolls restart from silence (Env Reset Amp).
Saved projects play their HLD, ATK, DEC and REL on the new curves.
